instruction.name: x86clrtm
instruction.description: Clear the x87 translation mode, disabling TOP-based remapping of the FPRs.

notes: LBT clear of the translation-mode bit.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm
throughput.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 50 --unroll2 200 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r12, 5' --asm 'x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm'
throughput.notes: The instruction clears a global x87 mode bit, so copies serialise.
